verses.pali: “Dveme, bhikkhave, puggalā loke uppajjamānā uppajjanti acchariyamanussā.
verses.english: “These two individuals, mendicants, arise in the world who are incredible human beings.

verses.pali: Tathāgato ca arahaṁ sammāsambuddho, rājā ca cakkavattī.
verses.english: The Realized One, the perfected one, the fully awakened Buddha; and the wheel-turning monarch.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve puggalā loke uppajjamānā uppajjanti acchariyamanussā”ti.
verses.english: These are the two individuals who arise in the world who are incredible human beings.”
